name: @verve/backend
description: Verve Dental Operational Suite — Node.js/TypeScript API server

scripts.test:receiving-integration: node -e "if(!process.env.DATABASE_URL){process.stderr.write('FATAL: DATABASE_URL must be set to run receiving integration tests.\nRun test:db:setup first, then set DATABASE_URL.\n');process.exit(1)}" && node --experimental-vm-modules ../node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js tests/supplierInvoiceReceiving.integration.test.ts --forceExit --verbose
scripts.test:pilotresetrls-integration:
node -e "if(!process.env.DATABASE_URL){process.stderr.write('FATAL: DATABASE_URL must be set to run Pilot Reset RLS integration tests.
These tests prove FORCE RLS enforcement via verve_app NOSUPERUSER role.
Run test:db:setup first, then set DATABASE_URL.
');process.exit(1)}" && node --experimental-vm-modules ../node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js tests/pilotResetRls.integration.test.ts --runInBand --forceExit --verbose
scripts.test:workflowrls-integration: node -e "if(!process.env.DATABASE_URL&&!process.env.WORKFLOW_RLS_DATABASE_URL){process.stderr.write('FATAL: DATABASE_URL or WORKFLOW_RLS_DATABASE_URL must be set for workflow-table RLS tests.\n');process.exit(1)}" && node --experimental-vm-modules ../node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js tests/workflowTableRls.integration.test.ts --runInBand --forceExit --verbose
scripts.test:clinicbrandrls-integration: node -e "const raw=process.env.CLINIC_BRAND_ASSETS_DATABASE_URL;if(!raw)throw new Error('CLINIC_BRAND_ASSETS_DATABASE_URL is required');const u=new URL(raw);if(u.hostname!=='localhost'||u.port!=='5432'||u.pathname!=='/verve_test_clinic_brand_assets')throw new Error('CLINIC_BRAND_ASSETS_DATABASE_URL must target the isolated local CI database')" && node --experimental-vm-modules ../node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js tests/clinicBrandAssets.postgres.integration.test.ts --runInBand --forceExit --verbose
scripts.test:weeklyrosterpdf-integration: node -e "const raw=process.env.WEEKLY_ROSTER_PDF_DATABASE_URL;if(!raw)throw new Error('WEEKLY_ROSTER_PDF_DATABASE_URL is required');const u=new URL(raw);const local=u.hostname==='127.0.0.1'&&u.port==='55432'&&u.pathname==='/wf_test_db';const ci=u.hostname==='localhost'&&u.port==='5432'&&u.pathname==='/verve_test_weekly_roster_pdf';if(!['postgres:','postgresql:'].includes(u.protocol)||(!local&&!ci))throw new Error('WEEKLY_ROSTER_PDF_DATABASE_URL must target an authorised disposable local or CI database')" && node --experimental-vm-modules ../node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js tests/weeklyRosterPdf.postgres.integration.test.ts --runInBand --forceExit --verbose --json --outputFile=.weekly-roster-pdf-jest-result.json && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const p='.weekly-roster-pdf-jest-result.json';const r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'));fs.unlinkSync(p);if(r.numPassedTests<2||r.numFailedTests!==0||r.numPendingTests!==0||r.numTodoTests!==0)throw new Error('Weekly Roster PDF PostgreSQL gate requires at least 2 passed real tests and zero failed/skipped/todo tests')"
scripts.test:database-tls-integration: node -e "if(!process.env.TLS_DATABASE_URL||!process.env.TLS_CA_CERT_PATH){process.stderr.write('FATAL: TLS_DATABASE_URL and TLS_CA_CERT_PATH must be set for PostgreSQL TLS tests.\n');process.exit(1)}" && node --experimental-vm-modules ../node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js tests/databaseTls.integration.test.ts --runInBand --forceExit --verbose
